name: Philbrook Hall
use: Dining hall for the east-side residence halls (Timbers), with Philbrook Cafe; weekdays only since fall 2025
builtText: Construction began 1968; Franzen design 1968-70; dedicated May 8, 1971
architect: Ulrich Franzen & Associates (original); CMK Architects (2005, 2008 renovations)
style: Late Modern brick (Franzen), opened up with glazing in 2005-08

renovations.what: Renovation and addition (CMK Architects): new entrances and large lobby, food stations replacing a single line, glazing cut into brick walls
Second phase (CMK Architects): additional dining room with its own servery, relocated dishwashing, soup and sandwich station overlooking the quad, screened loading dock

facts.text: Designed by Ulrich Franzen & Associates and built by Davison Construction and Boyce Construction from 1968, to offer a smaller, more personal dining experience modelled on UMass, URI, Syracuse and Southern Illinois.
Dedicated May 8, 1971 and named for Dr. Anna Lester Philbrook (class of 1928), a child psychiatrist and alumni trustee.
Originally seated 600 and could not keep up with demand; 2005 and 2008 renovations and additions enlarged it and reorganised the food stations.

Offers an allergen-friendly station, Mongolian grill, all-day breakfast and made-to-order toasted subs; booth seating, tables and a separate breakfast dining room. It is a 4-Star Certified Green Restaurant.
Single-level, with an automated front entrance via a stair-bypass walkway and an automated rear bridge entrance.

Closed on weekends from fall 2025: weekend traffic was much lower than weekday traffic while costs stayed the same, so weekend dining was consolidated at Holloway Commons; UNH said in October 2025 it would stay closed weekends.

verdict: Franzen's 1971 blank-walled brick dining hall, opened up in 2005–08 with colourful serveries; a student favourite for breakfast.
notes: No licensed photo found. Reference photos: low red-brick mass with large blank planar walls, reached by a concrete stair and bridge; CMK thumbnails (tiny) show colourful drum-shaped soffits over serveries and a warm-toned dining room. Old row's "cool roof" and "cafe renovated later" not re-verified. Late-night service (2016) may no longer apply.
judgeNotes: Reference photos show stark brick planes outside and warm, colourful interiors.
